history.text: I've got a few hours this afternoon and I want to write something if there's anything worth responding to. Anything moving in behavioral science today? Replication studies, nudge policy news, new experimental results?
Let me scan what's been moving. Anything you're specifically hoping is happening, or fully open?
Fully open. But remember — I only want to write if I have a differentiated angle. If everyone's already said what I'd say, I'd rather skip it and work on the newsletter instead.
Understood. I'll flag what's live and tell you where the gap is — or if there isn't one.

Also keep watching for any new developments around dark patterns regulation or nudge ethics in tech — if the FTC or EU makes a move, or a major app gets called out, that could be the hook I need for the fintech nudging piece.
I'll watch for regulatory and ethics developments in that space.
Cool. I'll be writing — ping me if something's time-sensitive or if a big replication result drops.
Will do. I'll stay quiet unless there's something worth your afternoon.
